Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Breast cancer

TEST PERFORMED
Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (FISH) for HER2 Gene Amplification

METHODOLOGY
Interphase FISH analysis was performed on formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissue sections using the MediSpec OG-7020 ERBB2 (17q12) / SE 17 dual-color probe set. The ERBB2 probe (orange signal) hybridizes to the HER2 gene locus at 17q12, and the SE 17 probe (green signal) hybridizes to the chromosome 17 centromere. Analysis was performed on 70 interphase nuclei and correlated with HER2 immunohistochemistry stained slides.

RESULTS

HER2 (ERBB2) FISH Analysis:
- Mean HER2 gene copy number per cell: 4.06
- Mean chromosome 17 centromere per cell: 1.89
- HER2/Chr17 ratio: 2.15
- Number of cells analyzed: 70

Result: POSITIVE for HER2 gene amplification

INTERPRETATION
Amplification of the HER2 (ERBB2) gene locus at 17q12 is detected. The HER2/Chr17 ratio of 2.15 meets criteria for HER2 positivity (ratio ≥2.0) according to ASCO/CAP 2018 guidelines for HER2 testing in breast cancer.

This result indicates HER2 positive status, which has important implications for treatment selection. Patients with HER2 positive breast cancer are eligible for HER2-targeted therapies including trastuzumab, pertuzumab, T-DM1, and other anti-HER2 agents.

REPORTING CRITERIA
This test was performed and interpreted according to the 2018 ASCO/CAP HER2 Testing Guidelines:
- HER2 Positive: HER2/Chr17 ratio ≥2.0 with average HER2 copy number ≥4.0 signals/cell
- HER2 Equivocal: HER2/Chr17 ratio <2.0 with average HER2 copy number ≥4.0 and <6.0 signals/cell
- HER2 Negative: HER2/Chr17 ratio <2.0 with average HER2 copy number <4.0 signals/cell
